register.ask_manager: Ask a manager when the count is out
register.ask_manager_help: Short or over by more than this at close needs a manager's code before the register closes.
register.close_reminder_help: After this time the bar shows Overdue, and Checkout becomes Close register when the cart is empty.
register.no_store_help: To run more than one register, create a store and add registers on its page.
register.open_close_register_help: Cashiers open with a float, record cash in and out, and count the drawer at close.
register.opening_float_help: Pre-filled when the register is opened. The cashier can type what is actually in the drawer.
register.site_defaults: Site defaults. Each store can customise these on its page.
store_details.refund_returns_policy_desc: Brief statement that will appear on POS receipts.
store_details.section_description: Information about your physical store, used on POS receipts and invoices. Leave a field blank to inherit the WooCommerce default shown as a placeholder.
store_details.upgrade_callout_body: Create a store to configure receipt templates, pricing, tax rates, and authorized users for each location.
store_tax_ids.callout_body: Add as many as you need — they all appear on the receipt.
store_tax_ids.empty: No additional store tax IDs configured.
store_tax_ids.label: Custom label
store_tax_ids.section_description_intro: Tax IDs printed on POS receipts and invoices. The first row uses the store country.
stores.section_description: Each store can override the receipt template, pricing, tax rates, and authorized users from its own edit screen.
